verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Datadog has an official first-party CLI (datadog-ci on Datadog's GitHub), so the product itself provides the capability. The evidence is a single thin pointer, with nothing on the CLI's scope, commands, or suitability for AI-native or agent workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of CLI scope and commands, evidence of coverage beyond CI use cases, evidence of agent or AI-native workflow fit, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
